## What's Changed

- Adds an opt-in audio-only compatibility stream for Tater Tube Player. The server copies compatible video without re-encoding it and converts only the first audio track to stereo AAC.
- Reports video and audio processing separately in active streams and the dashboard, including `Video: Direct` with `Audio: Transcoding (AAC)`.
- Keeps full H.264/AAC transcoding available as a fallback when the original video cannot be copied into the compatibility stream.
- Makes library browsing index-only so it no longer waits for one media probe per video.
- Moves missing-duration discovery into a parallel background maintenance pass and automatically rebuilds the Tube TV guide when that pass completes.
- Keeps the existing player, music, local-stream, and Tube TV routes backward compatible; audio-only transcoding is enabled only when explicitly requested.

## Upgrade

Pull the latest container and restart:

```bash
docker pull ghcr.io/tatertotterson/tater-tube-server:latest
docker restart tater-tube-server
```

No configuration migration is required. Tater Tube Player must use this release or newer to request the audio-only compatibility stream.
